definitions: A place where someone or something is located or has been put.
A particular way in which someone or something is placed or arranged.
A situation or set of circumstances, especially a complex or problematic one.
A point of view or attitude towards a matter.
examples: The team maintained its position at the top of the league.
She adopted a comfortable position on the sofa.
He applied for a position in marketing.
The company is in a difficult financial position.
What is your position on this issue?
